name: Ronda Afiliados
author: afiliadosronda

sections.description:
Ronda connects brands in Uruguay with influencers. Brands using WooCommerce 10.8 or later can connect their store directly from Ronda for brands. Open Mi tienda, choose WooCommerce, enter the HTTPS store address and approve read-only access to the catalog and orders.

Ronda attributes paid, verified sales using the promotional code on the order. The brand sets the promotion payment for eligible sales and the influencer receives the full agreed percentage. Ronda charges neither party a platform fee.

What does version 1.2.0 do on an existing site?

This download is the connector for Ronda’s earlier link-based integration. Instructions and pricing text on its admin screen describe that earlier service. New store connections use the native API workflow above.

When the store manager selects Conectar con Ronda in the plugin, it enables local referral tracking and opens Ronda with the public store address. If enabled, version 1.2.0 can record a referral for 24 hours and add it to an order submitted through classic checkout or Checkout Blocks. The current Ronda service uses promotional codes to attribute sales.

External service and data

The external service is Ronda. Installing or activating version 1.2.0 alone does not enable referral tracking. WooCommerce sends read-only credentials directly to Ronda over HTTPS when the store manager approves authorization. The manager can review the keys in WooCommerce settings.

With the current connection, Ronda reads product and variant identifiers, product images and URLs, prices, availability and currency. It reads order and line identifiers, coupon codes, amounts, taxes, payment dates and status, cancellations and refunds to check eligible sales. WooCommerce grants read-only access at the API level. The historical plugin also exposes setup diagnostics for authorized requests and public compatibility information about its version, protocol and referral window.

Privacy policy
Data processing agreement

Cookies and existing order data in version 1.2.0

When its tracking is enabled, the plugin uses the first-party cookies ronda_affiliate and ronda_affiliate_client. They hold an opaque referral and timestamps and expire after 24 hours. A direct visit does not extend the window. The plugin uses the marketing category of WP Consent API when available. On installations without WP Consent API, the store manager is responsible for configuring consent. The plugin supplies suggested text for WordPress’s Privacy Policy Guide.

The plugin includes its local order references in WooCommerce’s personal data export and erasure tools. Contact Ronda about records already held by the service. Retention and contact details are available in the privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Connecting a store today

  1. Use WooCommerce 10.8 or later on an HTTPS store.
  2. Sign in to your brand account at Ronda. In Mi tienda, select WooCommerce and enter the store address.
  3. Choose Conectar WooCommerce and approve the native read-only authorization in WooCommerce. Return to Ronda to check the connection and catalog.

The current integration works without installing this plugin.
sections.faq:
My site already has version 1.2.0. How do I stop recording referrals?

Open WooCommerce → Ronda and disable tracking. Deactivating the plugin also stops its hooks. Clear cached storefront HTML if it still serves the old script. Existing referral cookies expire within 24 hours. The current Ronda integration uses the promotional code recorded on the order.

Does uninstalling the plugin also remove orders or revoke a WooCommerce API key?

Uninstalling version 1.2.0 retains existing order metadata for reconciliation and removes its connector setting when the last installed copy is removed. WooCommerce manages API keys separately under Settings → Advanced → REST API. A key used by an active Ronda connection must remain valid for synchronization.

The plugin’s admin screen mentions a service fee. What are the current terms?

That text describes the earlier service. Ronda charges no platform fee. The brand funds the influencer’s agreed promotion payment for qualifying sales. See Ronda’s current terms.

Where do I get support?

Contact contacto@afiliadosronda.com. Keep API keys and customer information out of public support requests.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Synchronize payment, cancellation and refund status without a manual delivery or return-review step.
  • Align the connector with Ronda’s shared 60-day review period from confirmed payment. Any recorded refund cancels the commission.
  • Keep existing order metadata untouched for reconciliation.

1.1.2

  • Preserve the shared tracking setting while another installed copy of Ronda Afiliados remains during a migration to the directory version.

1.1.1

  • Confirm delivery or collection with one action in the order, with a clear explanation of the confirmation date and 30-day return period.
  • Avoid recording a return-review completion note when no return was open.

1.1.0

  • Added merchant-initiated connection, explicit tracking opt-in and authenticated automatic setup verification.
  • Added read-only setup diagnostics, privacy export/erasure integration and uninstall cleanup.
  • Added translated UI strings, documentation and dependency declarations for directory distribution.
  • Preserved the same attribution, checkout, delivery and return implementation for every store.

1.0.1

  • Added local JavaScript attribution support for cached storefront pages and WP Consent API integration.

1.0.0

  • Initial connector with classic/Blocks checkout attribution and delivery/return confirmation.

short_description: Legacy connector for existing Ronda installations. Connect a new WooCommerce store from Ronda using WooCommerce's native read-only API.

upgrade_notice.1.2.0: The connector no longer asks the store to confirm delivery or manage a return review. Existing attribution and order metadata remain unchanged.
upgrade_notice.1.1.2: When migrating from a privately installed copy, update the existing private copy and the directory copy to this release before removing the private copy. Existing connection, attribution and order records remain unchanged.
upgrade_notice.1.1.1: Delivery confirmation now uses a single button in the order. Existing delivery dates are preserved.
upgrade_notice.1.1.0: Open WooCommerce → Ronda and select Connect with Ronda to enable tracking. Existing orders remain unchanged. If migrating a privately installed copy, deactivate that copy before installing the directory version.
